## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

## Ihre Mitgliedschaft im Composites United e.V.

Rund 350 Mitglieder aus Industrie und angewandter Forschung bilden im Composites United ein starkes,
branchenübergreifendes Netzwerk für faserbasierte Hochleistungsanwendungen. Die Mitgliedschaft
eröffnet Zugang zu wertvollen B2B-Kontakten und gemeinsamen Projekten, stärkt durch gezielte
Öffentlichkeitsarbeit Ihre Sichtbarkeit und bietet Wissenstransfer, vielfältige Bildungsangebote
sowie Unterstützung bei der Erschließung internationaler Märkte.

[ Mehrwerte entdecken ][12]

## ITHEC 2026 - Jetzt Tickets und Ausstellungsflächen buchen!

Die ITHEC - renommierte internationale Konferenz und Ausstellung für thermoplastische
Verbundwerkstoffe - findet vom 28. bis 29. Oktober 2026 in Bremen statt. Sichern Sie sich jetzt Ihr
Ticket und planen Sie Ihre Beteiligung!

[ Mehr Informationen ][13]

In der neusten Ausgabe unseres Mitgliedermagazins erwarten Sie wieder viele spannende Innovationen
aus dem CU-Netzwerk, insbesondere zum diesjährigen Fokus-Thema "Future Defense". Lassen Sie sich von
der Kompetenz unseres großen Netzwerks überzeugen.

## Repräsentanzen

Der Composites United sucht weltweit nach Partnern, um die Entwicklung der Composite-Technologie
voranzutreiben.

## Mitglieder

Der Composites United besteht aus ca. 350 Mitgliedern verschiedener Branchen, Regionen und Länder,
Unternehmen und Institutionen.

## Projekte

Gemeinsame Projekte bringen die Mitglieder des Netzwerkes zu wichtigen Themen der Branche zusammen
und gestalten die Zukunft der Composites Branche.

## Arbeitsgruppen

Über 45 technische Arbeitsgruppen und zu allen relevanten Themen der Composites Branche.

## Kooperationspartner

Der CU kooperiert mit wichtigen Partnern im Bereich multimaterialen Leichtbau, um Kräfte zu bündeln
und Multiplikatoreffekte zu nutzen.

## Sponsoren

Unsere Sponsoren teilen mit uns die Leidenschaft für Innovationen und unterstützen den Verein bei
der Umsetzung seiner Ziele.

adhesives.

plastics coatings, PVC top coats and exterior paints.

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

The biggest frustration of our customers is finding the right products, in the right quantities, and
getting them in their hands as fast as possible. Due to the exacting tolerances and requirements of
advanced composite materials, the industry as a whole is not set up to meet the needs of smaller
quantities and fast turn around.

With more than 30 years of experience in the composites industry, our management and staff are
committed to delivering the highest quality products, unsurpassed customer service, competitive
pricing, and rapid action response to your critical needs. Many of our advanced composites
are stocked in our freezer and shipped same day.

# Top Products

### Food Grade PVAC

Food grade polyvinyl acetate (pvac) contains no anti-oxidants or stabilizers. It is transparent,
water white or pale yellow, and supplied in form of granules or flakes.

[ Read More... ][45]

### Industry Grade Pvac

Industry Grade Polyvinyl Acetate is a solid beads form polymer. The pvac resin is prepared by
polymerization of vinyl acetate. We can customize viscosity, molecular weight, and transparency.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly

doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation

cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

record built on the technical expertise of Ashland and strengthened by INEOS’s operational
excellence. Now as ALTA Performance Materials, we stand as an independent, forward-focused company
dedicated to elevating performance in composites, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, shaping
the future of materials.

[ATLA tagline Elevating Performance in Composites]

## This is just the beginning


An established business with global reach, a new name, a bold vision and a relentless pursuit of
excellence.

[ Markets ][33]
[Red car tail light material]

## Our foundation is strong and our vision is clear.


## We value what matters most:

**People**
The heart of our success, bringing expertise and passion to everything we do in service to our
colleagues and customers.

**Premium Brands**
A portfolio of industry-leading recognised products including AME®, AROTRAN®, AROPOL®, ENGUARD®,
MAXGUARD®, MODAR®, HETRON®, NEULON®, POLARIS® and DERAKANE®.

 

**Partnership**
Built on trust, collaboration and shared success.

 

**Proactivity**
Pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with forward focused solutions including our ENVIREZ®
Sustainability Platform.

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# Typical Applications

### As low profile additive in SMC production

HV-1 Polyvinyl Acetate (pvac) solid resins are used as low-profile additives in FRP composites to
achieve zero-shrinkage, class A surface quality, full viscosity control and design flexibility.

[ Read More... ][56]

### Polyvinyl Acetate for All Purpose Glue

The PVAC (Polyvinyl Acetate) solid resins for Adhesive usage has a great advantage that is
Eco-Friendly. The usage is very simple. Just dissolve the PVAc & Poly vinyl acetate into Organic
Solvent to make it liquid.

[ Read More... ][57]

### PVAC as LPA in BMC production

polyvinyl acetate solid resins are used as low-profile additives in fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP)
composites to achieve zero-shrinkage, class A surface quality, full viscosity control and design
flexibility.

[ Read More... ][58]

### PVAC As anti shrinkage additive in FRP Pultrusion

Polyvinyl acetate for pultrusion is used as anti-shrinkage additive to control shrinkage, prevent
the middle crack of thick pultrusion product, prevent the fracture and porosity in the pultrusion
process etc.

[ Read More... ][59]

### PVAC for Gumbase Produce

Food grade polyvinyl acetate (pvac) is largely used in rubber based gumbase production. The pvac
resin is the main substances of gumbase besides SBR rubber.

[ Read More... ][60]
